arguments.value: This agreement gives Food For Athletes/Gridiron BioNutrients the right to use the NFL Alumni’s logo and name to market certain products worldwide for three years, starting November 1, 2017, but only with NFLA’s prior written approval. In return, the company pays a $35,000 upfront license fee to the Northern California chapter, a $10,000 promotional fee to NFLA in quarterly installments, and $0.05 per unit sold of the licensed products, with unit counts assigned to each product type. The company also commits to provide product donations, support membership renewals, offer discounts and wellness information to NFLA members, maintain marketing efforts, and operate a call center for member questions. NFLA/NFLA-NC agree to promote the company through email, newsletters, social media, sponsorship listings, and appearances. The company must protect NFLA’s trademarks, cannot sublicense or register them, and must stop using them after the agreement ends, though it has a 90-day sell-off period for remaining inventory. Either side can terminate for uncured breach, NFLA can end it if the company becomes insolvent, and disputes are governed by California law and arbitration.
